verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own way to explore the API interactively: the official CLI lets you discover endpoints, preview requests and inspect schemas, and it runs real calls against a sandbox by default. However, this is a terminal tool, not an interactive web API reference, and no runnable examples are shown embedded in the reference docs. missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference with in-page try-it/runnable examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the explore experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Explore the API interactively — discover endpoints, preview requests, and inspect schemas before you commit to a full integration.
exposes a broad slice of the Airwallex API as terminal commands, so you can read and write your Airwallex resources in sandbox or production
